description: Needs the signed-in link https://a2a2p.com/co-invent/mcp. On this public link it answers with how your person connects it. Older name for co_invent_read, kept so a connector with a saved tool list keeps working. Read any part of a pass, as a person reads it in the app. part: list (what's there), brief, shortlist (the brief's ideas, then best_possible: Debbie's best possible solution, designed to Debbie's own brief, free of the person's soft limits and never of safety, the law or physics, with its one quality score out of 100, judged against her brief, and the brief itself; develop it by its id like any other), concept, brainstorm, review, mustdos, requirements, spec, bom, risks, business, market, engineering, diagrams, patent, claimcheck, rounds, app, checks, provenance, activity, debbie, attribution, questions (Debbie's questions, her reading of why it matters, and the answers), siblings (where each idea from the same shortlist stands, and the earlier passes), undeveloped (the saved ideas, with their days left), commons (a2a2p's claims repository search: prior art found while reading, unpublished Invention Commons listings kept as precedence risks with their listing dates, and the package's notices of Commons inventions whose claims may overlap the drafted claims, by public teaser only) or reading (the reading step's ranked list of everything in the idea and its attachments, function and mechanism first, each item with its source, and how many of each attachment's items reached the brainstorm, design, concepts, shortlist, requirements and package); export gives the whole package as one JSON; pack gives the private links to the finished package for its owner.
name: co_invent_pass_read
